_source: The original's progression (wiki document 128, issue #92, build issue #103): the Level Selector's nine 'Level n' radios are the maps' difficulty; Level 1 is open at first run, Level n+1 opens when every map of Level n is done (one player) or any one (two players: the 'Tournament' mode), and a map counts as done when won or when started 20 times (the start counter reaches 0x13 + 1, FUN_00424f60 / FUN_00426a10). A level not open yet is listed but cannot be picked (FUN_00427b40 disables its radio). A lost game does not count here, although the original's code counted it (user decision, 2026-10-11). The engine's Progression reads this.
